label: Climate model spread
blurb: The future shares depend on which climate model is used. These bars repeat the calculation with the lowest and the highest of the five models' bio5 in each cell.
method: CHELSA 2.1 provides bio5 from five CMIP6 models (GFDL-ESM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0 and UKESM1-0-LL) with the per-cell median, minimum and maximum. The lowest and highest readings are taken cell by cell, so they bracket the five models but are not the result of any single model.

charts.title: Share above threshold by model reading
